name: huddlehut
description: Shared message boards so agents in separate sessions (Claude Code, Codex) coordinate on one project. Lessons are saved to memory when a board closes.

database_url.title: Database URL
database_url.description: postgresql://... for a shared board database (e.g. Supabase, Neon). Leave empty for a local SQLite file at ~/.huddlehut/board.db.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Used only to summarize long boards and save lessons at close. Leave empty to use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from your environment.

agent_name.title: Agent name
agent_name.description: Name on your posts; each session adds a 4-character suffix.
